api_audit_events_scope_check.name: api_audit_events_scope_check
api_audit_events_scope_check.value: workspace_id is not null or organization_id is not null

api_mutations_completed_result_check.name: api_mutations_completed_result_check
api_mutations_completed_result_check.value: "api_mutations"."state" <> 'completed' or ("api_mutations"."response_status" is not null and "api_mutations"."completed_at" is not null)

contracts_dates_check.name: contracts_dates_check
contracts_dates_check.value: "contracts"."ends_on" is null or "contracts"."effective_on" is null or "contracts"."ends_on" >= "contracts"."effective_on"

quote_estimates_conversion_target_check.name: quote_estimates_conversion_target_check
quote_estimates_conversion_target_check.value:
(
				("quote_estimates"."status" = 'converted' and (case when "quote_estimates"."converted_invoice_id" is null then 0 else 1 end + case when "quote_estimates"."converted_order_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) = 1)
				or
				("quote_estimates"."status" <> 'converted' and "quote_estimates"."converted_invoice_id" is null and "quote_estimates"."converted_order_id" is null)
			)

shipping_rates_weight_band_check.name: shipping_rates_weight_band_check
shipping_rates_weight_band_check.value: "shipping_rates"."min_weight_grams" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_weight_grams" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_weight_grams" > "shipping_rates"."min_weight_grams"

shipping_rates_order_band_check.name: shipping_rates_order_band_check
shipping_rates_order_band_check.value: "shipping_rates"."min_order_cents" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_order_cents" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_order_cents" > "shipping_rates"."min_order_cents"
